title: Gay Plaza Resource Pack
description: A resource pack changing a few named items for a multiplayer SMP.
body:
A resource pack for the AtriocSMP, mostly themed around the Gay Plaza area on the server.
# Features
- Custom Waystone Icon for the Gay Plaza waystone
- Custom models and textures for Gay Plaza Collectible #2

# Future updates
- More models and textures for future Gay Plaza Collectibles
- Custom horse models when named after real life race horses
